admin.journeys.title: Journeys
admin.journeys.create_note: Start a fresh journey from scratch. You can author mementos, add photos, and attach GPS tracks later in the editor.
admin.journeys.delete_note: Permanent — this cannot be undone. The journey, its route, all mementos, photos, and stop candidates will be permanently removed.
admin.journeys.delete_confirmation: Delete "{title}" permanently? All memories and photos in this journey are removed too.
admin.connectors.scan_note: Choose a folder containing route.gpx, photos/, and optional photos.jsonl. Scan is read-only; import creates reviewable candidates only.

admin.connectors.route.description: Pulls the GPS track and writes gps_route.

admin.connectors.photos.description: Read-only — Immich assets, nothing is saved.
admin.connectors.inbox.title: Intake inbox
admin.connectors.inbox.description: Runs the intake planner over the journey's sources and proposes stop candidates for review.
admin.connectors.inbox.empty: No stop candidates yet. Run "Plan intake" to generate some.
admin.connectors.registry_unavailable: Kind registry unavailable: {error}. Promoting is disabled until this loads.
admin.connectors.candidate.conflict: Someone else changed this candidate — reload the journey and try again.
admin.connectors.candidate.no_kind: No kind available to promote into — check the kind registry.
admin.connectors.discard_note: Discarding hides this candidate but remembers it — a future intake plan won't propose it again.
admin.mementos.title: Mementos
admin.mementos.location_edge_note: This kind spans a from → to route — enter both endpoints.
admin.mementos.location_point_note: This kind sits at a single point.
admin.mementos.location_validation_note: Non-draft saves must resolve to a valid location.
admin.mementos.snap_error: Couldn't snap this point — enter a valid lat/lng first, or check the journey has a route.
admin.mementos.kind_registry_missing: Kind registry has no template for "{kind}" — kind_data can't be validated here.
admin.mementos.kind_read_only: Read-only — this kind doesn't have a dedicated form yet.
admin.mementos.photo_upload_note: Uploads are stored privately. The public build resizes photos and strips EXIF metadata. Maximum 20 MiB per image; use JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
admin.mementos.delete_note: Permanent — this cannot be undone, and its photos are removed with it. If this memento was derived from an import source, a future import may re-create it.
admin.mementos.delete_confirmation: Delete this memento permanently? Photos are removed too. A future import may re-create a source-derived memento like this one.
admin.mementos.conflict.discard_mine: Discard my edits and load theirs
admin.mementos.conflict.changed: Someone else changed this memento since it was loaded ({fields}). Your edits are still here.
admin.mementos.conflict.unknown: Someone else changed this memento since it was loaded. Your edits are still here.
admin.site.deploy_note: This is the offline, local deployment target: building compiles published content into a static artifact directory on this machine. No admin data, drafts, or credentials leave it. The artifact can be hosted by any static file server; this page's preview link lets you verify it locally first.
admin.site.preview_unavailable_note: The preview will serve the compiled JSON only until the public SPA is built (run make web-build) — the built-in server overlays the artifact on that build.
admin.site.identity_note: Design, title, and style projected to the public site's site.json.
